claim: A pinned Codex app-server controller can make the declared projection the only cross-encounter causal channel while directly receipting the exact model-visible tool inventory and authoritative terminal tool events.
hypothesis: The OT-0002 categorical boundary result reproduces when built-in tools are captured at prompt construction, tool calls are counted from item/completed events, and an independent clean process reconstructs the same deterministic evaluator projection.
cheapest_decisive_falsifier: In any isolation trial, recover a forbidden canary through a directly probed channel, reuse a backend thread identity or workspace, permit denied network egress, expose an undeclared MCP surface, recover the projection canary under null ablation, observe a model-visible inventory other than the frozen digest, omit a terminal tool event, or fail independent deterministic evaluator reconstruction.
candidate: fresh app-server thread and workspace with one bounded opaque projection, a pinned prompt-construction inventory receipt, and event-stream action accounting
promotion_gate: the implementation commit is clean and predates unsealed actor results
every actor turn has a parseable prompt-construction inventory receipt and all receipts match the frozen canonical digest
terminal item/completed events are sufficient to enforce the frozen per-turn and total budgets
a separate clean process reconstructs matching deterministic evaluator-projection bytes from the sealed raw artifact
the privacy and repository-size audit and full test suite pass

evaluation_transition.reason: OT-0002 showed that fresh mandatory identifiers and timestamps make raw-artifact byte equality incompatible with the reset contract, and that turn/completed snapshots omit terminal command events.
independent_anchors: the frozen OT-0002 categorical thresholds and controls
fresh backend thread and workspace identities
immutable raw artifacts with separately recorded content identities
the exact model-visible inventory digest captured at prompt construction
evaluation_transition.replacement_rule: Compare canonical deterministic evaluator projections in a separate clean process; do not require distinct raw runs containing fresh identities and timestamps to have identical bytes.
evaluation_transition.stale_scope: Only conclusions that depended on raw-artifact byte equality or turn-snapshot tool counts are stale; OT-0002 remains conditional historical evidence and its raw artifact is unchanged.

red_line_review: This is a harness-boundary experiment, not a learning claim.
OT-0002 is not reclassified and its failed frozen gates remain preserved.
Actor recall is supporting behavioral evidence and never substitutes for direct boundary probes.
No prior actor thread may be resumed in an isolation trial.
All raw canaries, paths, thread identifiers, complete tool schemas, events, and model outputs remain in the external evidence store.
The drifting model alias is admissible only for boundary development and cannot support a promoted OT-1 learning comparison.
An inventory mismatch, missing receipt, budget breach, or failed independent reconstruction forces a conditional or rejected disposition.
